title: Karbala ka lene inteqaam kijiye zahoor
body:
KARBALA KA LENE INTEQAM KIJIYE ZAHOOR YA IMAAM
Zalimoun Ke Qabze Me Hai Aj Siriya
Qabre Binte Murtuza Ko Qaid Kardiya
Hogaya Udaas Sher-e-Shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham Me Shahe Ke Dil Hamare Doobe Jate Hai
Majliso Mei Aap Humko Yaad Aate Hai
Muntazir Hai Aap Ke Ghulam
Qabr Mei Nahi Hai Ab Bhi fatima Ko Chain
<<DIVIDER>>
Zalimoun Ko Khall Raha Hai Matam-e-Hussain
Aake Kijiye Zulm Ko Tamam
Bekasoun Ke Karbala Ke Bhooke Pyasoun Ka
Binte Murtuza Ke Dono Shahzadoun Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Badla Aake Lijiye Imaam
Thokare Qadam Qadam Pe Khate Hai Hussain
Noujawan Ki Lash Youn Uthate Hai Hussain
Tha Laboun Pe Bawafa Ka Naam
<<DIVIDER>>
Pherdi Gale Pe Shahe Ke Shimr Ne churi
Ediya Ragadna Shahe Ka Waqt-e-Aaqri
Bhool Hum Na Payenge Imaam
Faqr-e-Mustafa Aye Faqr-e-Yousuf-e-Hazeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Baarwe Imaam Aye Ali ke Jaanasheen
Aap Per durood Aur Salam
Ho-Chuke Hai Ahle Baith Haye Darbadar
Dekhkar Nazare Ko Ye Nouke Naize Per
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoon Rote Hai Shah-e-Anaam
Waris-e-Hussain Aab Zahoor Keejiye
Aake Mushkiloun Ko Dour Keejiye
Hyder Aap Ke Hai Ghulam
